title: Leon Slater: the next generation takes flight
summary: Leon Slater turns X Division potential into a championship breakthrough. His encounters with Moose and Cedric Alexander lead into a later pursuit of Nic Nemeth’s world title.

chapters.title: The youngest X Division champion
chapters.result: Slater defeats Moose to win the X Division championship.
chapters.context: AJ Styles returns to acknowledge the new champion, linking the division’s founding generation with Slater’s breakthrough.

chapters.title: Slater survives Cedric’s challenge
chapters.result: Leon defeats Cedric Alexander to retain the X Division title.
chapters.context: Alexander brings the belt into play, but Slater turns the situation against him and finishes with the Swanton 450.

chapters.title: A world-title challenger stands his ground
chapters.result: Slater defeats Joe Alonzo, then confronts Nic Nemeth.
chapters.context: Nemeth retreats and Slater poses with the belts as their announced Bound for Glory match approaches. This entry records the build; the future match has no result in this collection.
